additional_info.body:
Dear
Orel Lachiani
,
Following the timestamp that you mentioned to us and after reviewing the logs, it appears that the emergency stop button was pressed, as you can see in the screenshot.
If this is not the case and you are certain about it, we may need to perform a site check of the 24V safety circuit.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472678-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / R4 170001684] Charger not available CRM:02832000812
additional_info.body:
Dear Younes,
We visited the charging station over the weekend and found a disconnected wire from the 24V of the Safety relay.
Thanks for the support, the ticket can be closed.
Br,
Orel
